verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core product delivers autonomous background automation: connectors sync data automatically on schedules without pipeline maintenance, and transformations execute automatically after syncs or on a set schedule, all running continuously without manual intervention. This is fundamentally about scheduled/autonomous data movement rather than AI-agent-driven decision-making. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-specific autonomous reasoning/adaptation (beyond scheduled automatic syncs), and independent verification that automations run reliably without silent failures (community notes occasional sync issues).
